mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS below 0.5%) indicate accommodative monetary policy, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in federal funds rates above 3.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 3.5%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate and declines in non-farm payrolls indicate deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 4.0%), rising housing starts (HOUST) signal robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 4.0 and HOUST rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) reflects expanding manufacturing output, boosting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 4.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank hawkishness and negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL YoY > 4.0), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 4.0%) combined with stable or rising Fed funds rates (FEDFUNDS) indicates a tightening monetary cycle, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 4.0 and FEDFUNDS >= 3.5%, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 3.5%), rising non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate strong labor market conditions, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
